description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kanattagoda South, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820012
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner details, and encumbrances) in various locations. The content focuses entirely on land ownership, title settlements, and property registrations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories present.
